_meta.role: Applied AI ML - Payments Machine Learning (Associate)

summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Builds and evaluates machine learning and generative AI systems end to end: transformers and LLMs from scratch in PyTorch, 8-bit quantization benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K and ARC, and vision-language transformers fine-tuned with Hugging Face. Deploys models with TensorRT, ONNX and systemd-managed services, applying Python software engineering, profiling and measured latency-accuracy trade-offs.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT document-understanding transformer for structured field extraction, lifting validation accuracy 55% to 93%.
Built preprocessing, feature engineering and training pipelines in PyTorch with the Hugging Face VisionEncoderDecoder API.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite to move from training to serving.
Curated and annotated a custom detection dataset, defining the labelling strategy and class definitions.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a feature engineering and batch-loading data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16/VGG-19/ResNet-50 backbones; designed the Dice Score and IoU evaluation.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Built a Python GUI (PyQt, Matplotlib) for real-time data acquisition and analysis; GitLab version control, JupyterHub docs.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B, monitoring peak VRAM and inference latency with pynvml and psutil.
Built the evaluation harness across HellaSwag, GSM8K and ARC: <1% accuracy loss at +0.09 perplexity.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and a custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled pick-and-place system as a three-layer Flutter / Flask-SocketIO / Jetson WebSocket service.
Integrated an LLM-powered workflow: Gemini intent classification, faster-whisper STT, TensorRT YOLO serving (5.2x).
Deployed the Jetson inference service as a systemd unit with auto-restart backoff; 100% pick reliability, 10 trials.
